Find |b|.

Show that the capacity of the container is 32.8 litres.

At 1040 the container is empty. Water flows into the container at a rate of 2 litres per hour until the container is full. At 12 10 there are x litres of water in the container. Find x as a percentage of 32.8.

Calculate the area of the shaded segment.
Calculate the shortest distance from B to the circumference of the circle.
